title: Voter Registration for 2026 General Elections Opens Nationwide
summary: The Election Commission has announced the opening of voter registration for the 2026 general elections. Citizens can register online or at local booths.

title: Digital ID Integration for Seamless Voting Experience
summary: A new initiative to link digital IDs with voter records has been launched to prevent fraud and speed up the check-in process at polling stations.

title: New Polling Booths Announced in Rural Districts
summary: Over 5,000 new polling booths will be established in remote areas to ensure accessibility for all voters in the upcoming 2026 elections.

title: Youth Participation Reaches Record High in Early Surveys
summary: Early interest surveys indicate that youth participation in the 2026 election cycle is expected to surpass all previous records.

title: Candidate Nomination Period Set for June 2026
summary: The period for filing candidate nominations has been officially scheduled for June 1st to June 15th, 2026.
